trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: سُبْحَانَ الْعَزِيْزِ بِقُدْرَتِهِ الْمَالِكِ بِغَلَبَتِهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَخْرُجُ شَیْءٌ عَنْ قَبْضَتِهٖ، وَلَا اَمْرٌ اِلَّا بِيَدِهِ الَّذِيْ يَجُوْدُ مُبْتَدِئًا وَمَسْؤُوْلًا وَيَنْعَمُ مَعِيْدًا، هُوَ الْحَمِيْدُ الْمَجِيْدُ نَحْمَدَهُ بِتَوْفِيْقِهٖ، فَنِعَمُهٗ بِذٰلِكَ جُدُدٌ لَا تُحْصٰى، وَنُمَجِّدَهٗ بِآلَائِهٖ وَبْدَلَالَاتِهٖ فَاَيَادِيْهِ لَا تُكَافَىْ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ يَمْلِكُ الْمَالِكِيْنَ، وَيُعِزُّ الْاَعْزَاۗءِ، وَيُذِّلُ الْاَذَلِّيْن۔

lines.rarabic: SUBHAA-NAL A’ZEEZE BE-QUDRATE-HIL MAALEKE BE-GHALA-BATE-HIL LAZEE LAA YAKH-ROJO SHAIY-OON A’N QABZA-TEHI, WA LAA AMROON ILLAA BE-YADE-HIL LAZEE YAJOO-DO MUB-TADE-AN WA MAS-OO-LAN WA YAN-A’MO MA-E’E-DAN, HOWAL HAMEE-DUL MAJEEDO NAH-MADA-HO BE-TAUFEE-QE-HI, FA-NE’AMAHU BE-ZAALE-KA JODO-DOON LAA TOHSAA, WA NO-MAJJE-DAHU BE-AALAA-E-HI WABDA-LAA LAATE-HI FA-AYAA-DEEHE LAA TOKAA FEE WAL-HAMDO LILLAA-HIL LAZEE YAMLE-KUL MAALE-KEENA, WA YO-I’Z-ZUL A’ZAAA-E WA YUZZE-LUL AZAL-LEENA.

trans.en: Glory be to God who is Exalted in Might due to His Power. Glory be to God who is Exalted in Might due to His Power. He is the One from whose control nothing can escape. Nothing is decreed except by His Hand! He bestows without being asked, and with being asked. He continues His blessings. He is the Praised, the Noble. We praise Him when He gives us success! His blessings are new and uncountable. We glorify Him for His Bounties and for His Proofs that cannot be compensated for. And praise be to God, Who rules the rulers, gives power to the powerful and debases the debased.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَيْلَةَ سَّبْعَ عَشْرَةٍ، عَشْرَ وَهِيْ اَوَّلُ عُقُوْدَ الْاَعْدَادَ، وَسَّبْعَ وَهِيَ شَرِيْفَةَ الْآحَادَ، لَاحِقَةٌۢ بِنَعْتِ سَّابِقِهٖ وَيْلٌ لِمَنْ اَمْضَاهُنَّ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ لَكَ يَا مَوْلَاهٖ قَضَاكَ، وَلَا بِقُرْبٍ اِلَيْكَ اَرْضَاكَ وَاَنَا اَحَدٌ اَهْلُ الْوَيْلَ، صَدَّتَّنِيْ عَنْكَ بَطْنَةُ الْمَآكِلْ وَالْمَشَارِبْ وَغَرَّنِيْ بِكَ اَمْرُ الْمُسَارِبْ وَسَعَةُ الْمَذَاهِبْ، وَاجْتَذَبَتَنِيْ اِلٰى لَذَّاتِهَا سُنَّتِيْ، وَرَكِبْتُ الْوَطِيْئَةَ اللَّذِيْذَةَ مِنْ غَفْلَتِيْ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNA HAAZE-HIL LAIY-LATA LAIY-LATAS SAB-A’ A’SH-RATIN, A’SH-RA WA HEE AWWALO O’QOO-DAL A’DAADA, WAS-SAB-A’ WA HEYA SHAREE-FATAL AA-HAADA, LAA HEQA-TOON BE-NA’TIS SAABE-QEHI WAIY-LOON LEMAN AMZAA-HUNNA BE-GHAIY-RE HAQQIN LAKA YAA MAWLAA-HI QAZAA-KA, WA LAA BE-QURBIN ILAIY-KA ARZAA-KA WA ANAA AHA-DOON AHLUL WAIY-LA, SADDAT-TANEE A’N-KA BATNA-TUL MAAKIL WAL MA-SHAA-RIB WA GHARRA-NEE BEKA AMRUL MASAA-RIB WA SA-A’TUL MAZAA-HIB, WAJ-TAZA-BATA-NEE ILAA LAZZAA-TEHAA SUNNATEE WA RAKIB-TUL WATEE-A-TAL LAZEE-ZATA MIN GHAF-LA-TEE.

trans.en: O my God! This is seventeenth night, ten is the first of the digits in the decades and seven is the most honoured of the single digits that is connected to it. O Master! Woe be upon me who lets this night pass without respecting Your Right and tries to please You in ways other than approaching You I am one such person since I have been held back from You by overeating and overdrinking I was fooled by the various roads and the extensive means. My drowsiness led me to the worldly pleasures and I rode on the waves of such pleasures out of my ignorance.

arabic.text: فَاطْرُدْ عَنِّي الْاِغْتِرَارِ، وَاَنْقِذْنِيْ وَانْفُ بِيْ عَلَى الْاِسْتِبْصَارِ، وَاحْفَظْنِيْ مِنْ يَدِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَسَلِّمْنِيْ اِلَى الْيَقْظَةِ بِسَعَادَةٍ مِّنْكَ تُمْضِيْهَا وَتَقْضِيْهَا لِيْ، وَتُبَيِّضْ وَجْهِيْ لَدَيْك، وَتُزْلِفُنِيْ عِنْدَكْ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ، وَصَلَى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ وَآلِهٖ وَسَلَّمْ۔

lines.rarabic: FATRUD A’NNIL IGH-TERAA-RE, WA AN-QIZNEE WANFO BEE A’LAIY-YAL IS-TIB-SAARE, WAH-FAZNEE MIN YADIL GHAF-LATE WA SALLIM-NEE ILAL YAQ-ZATE BE-SA-A’A-DATIN MINKA TUMZEE-HAA WA TAQZEE-HAA LEE, WA TO-BAIYYIZ WAJHEE LA-DAIY-KA, WA TUZLE-FONEE I’N-DAK YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA, WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIN NABIYYE WA AALE-HI WA SALLAM.

trans.en: Please fend off delusions from me, save me and grant me good insight. And protect me against negligence, and secure me with awareness with prosperity from Yourself which you endorse and destine for me and brighten my face near you and bring me closer to Yourself O the most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Please bestow Your peace and blessings on Muhammad and his Household.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
